Packed transaction record with CU fields, source data, flags, and expanded account lookup tables.

# Purpose
This header defines the packed transaction record `fd_txn_p_t` used in the `disco` transaction path. The `fd_txn_p` structure stores the raw transaction payload, compute-unit accounting fields for pack and bank stages, the blockhash slot, arrival time, source information, and status flags. The `TXN` macro provides access to the embedded `fd_txn_t` object stored in the aligned byte array, and `fd_txn_e_t` extends the packed record with alternate account address storage for address lookup use.
